purpose: Frozen before any run: fresh-seed CUDA ensemble screening and repeated timing of the shipped exact/table radiative-moment policies after #805, using one committed source for every variant.
hardware_preflight: same-seed in-process replay for every case and variant at 256 histories

ensemble.rule: entire paired difference confidence interval inside equivalence margins; fewer than 30 changed pairs or zero variance is unresolved; unresolved is not pass
ensemble.multiplicity: per-comparison 99% intervals over 8 cases x 2 variants x 6 metrics; reported as screening, no family-wise qualification claim

benchmark.order: alternate exact/table first by repeat parity; each run is a fresh process with one in-process warmup
benchmark.claim_limit: measured ratio of shipped policies at matched histories on one RTX 5080; not an equal-achieved-precision or Geant4 comparison

cpu_heldout: moment-heldout-788.json rerun in full from the beginning on the production harness (job 2669 incomplete records are not reused).

amendments.change: SiO2 compound histories 50000 -> 20000 in ensemble and benchmark
